page: Microsoft Azure E32-8ds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Edsv6 family, virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V. It features an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz with 4 physical cores, 2 threads per core, and 8 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration is highly memory-dense, providing 256.0 GB of RAM, which equates to 32.0 GB of memory per core. Additionally, the server includes 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2051.0 and strong text processing capabilities. Large-block memory bandwidth reads reach 66.17 GB/sec, while write speeds are recorded at 45.13 GB/sec. However, a notable tradeoff is the Passmark memory score of 1716.72, which falls into the weak category. For language model tasks, the server achieves a strong text generation speed of 320.89 tokens/sec on a small 135M model, but drops to a weak 8.29 tokens/sec for a medium 7B model.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and the inclusion of local NVMe SSD storage, this server offers high resource density for memory-intensive workloads without the cost overhead of additional unneeded CPU cores. It is suited for memory-optimized databases, caching layers, text processing pipelines, and lightweight inference tasks that fit within its memory capacity but do not require heavy multi-core compute scaling.
